summary: Play an original interactive story without Wi-Fi.
page_description: Explore an original text adventure with touch shortcuts and a comfortable reading layout.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who wants a story that answers back.
job: Play an interactive story without Wi-Fi, and put it down without losing your place.
offline: The story and your saves live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: your saved place in the story
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a paused story continues

non_goals: It does not download new stories.
It does not read the story aloud.
